definitions.explanation: Having a relaxed, unhurried attitude without worry or anxiety. Can be positive (carefree) or slightly negative (careless, oblivious to problems).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{呑気|のんき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{笑|わら}っている→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: He has an easygoing personality and is always smiling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締切|しめきり}→締切：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、{呑気|のんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧。
examples.english: The deadline is near; this is no time to be carefree and playing around.

examples.japanese: {呑気|のんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}えていたら→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧、⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: Because I was too laid-back about it, I missed my chance.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
- {呑気|のんき} can praise (carefree, unbothered) or criticize (too relaxed when one ought to worry): {呑気|のんき}なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧ (this is no time to be so complacent). Context and tone decide which.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呑気|のんき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an easygoing person
- {呑気|のんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to take things easy, to be unconcerned
- {呑気|のんき}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: a complacent way of looking at things

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧: leisurely; describes a relaxed pace or mood and is usually neutral or positive (though it can fault someone for lacking urgency), while {呑気|のんき} describes an attitude and can imply carelessness
- ⟦{楽観的|らっかんてき}→楽観的：06090_rakkanteki⟧: optimistic; expecting things to turn out well, not merely not worrying

WRITING:
- Also written {暢気|のんき}; {呑気|のんき} is the usual spelling, and kana のんき is common.
